# bg_logs

Read bounded output from a background task for deliberate inspection; this is not a waiting primitive. Output is capped at 50.0KB for model safety and points to the full output file when truncated.

| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `taskId` | yes | string | Task ID or unambiguous prefix |
| `maxBytes` | no | number | Maximum bytes to return, capped at 50.0KB. Default: 50.0KB. |
| `tail` | no | boolean | Read the tail of the log when true, head when false. Default: true. |
